tasks.label: validate: active python file
args: if [[ "${file}" != *.py ]]; then echo "ERROR: Active file is not a .py file: ${file}"; echo "Open a run*.py (or selector.py) and press F5."; exit 1; fi; case "${relativeFile}" in run_with_log.py|scripts/*|verification/compare.py) echo "ERROR: ${relativeFile} runs on the PC. It cannot be sent to the hub."; echo "Open the run*.py you want to run (or selector.py) and press F5."; exit 1;; esac

if ('${fileExtname}' -ne '.py') { Write-Host 'ERROR: Active file is not a .py file: ${file}'; Write-Host 'Open a run*.py (or selector.py) and press F5.'; exit 1 }; if ('${relativeFile}' -match '^(run_with_log\.py|scripts[\\/].*|verification[\\/]compare\.py)$') { Write-Host 'ERROR: ${relativeFile} runs on the PC. It cannot be sent to the hub.'; Write-Host 'Open the run*.py you want to run (or selector.py) and press F5.'; exit 1 }
